hypothesis: Discarding annotation-corner-sensitive pair orders improves coordinate action selection more than ordinary ranking or dropping the same number of comparisons at random.
permission: Candidate18 passed its fixed nuisance/headroom gate. This permits only tiny heads, not detector training.
data: Exactly candidate18 cached128 fitting and64 head-held-out train images, same normalized68-dimensional prediction-only geometry and6 actions. Same detector and previously viewed scenes; no independent generalization claim.

labels.nominal: All15 unordered valid action pairs with nominal same-owner IoU abs gap>0.01.
labels.stable: Subset whose oriented IoU advantage exceeds0.01 at every one of17 candidate18 GT variants.
labels.thinned: For EACH OWNED ANCHOR, uniformly sample without replacement exactly the stable subset's pair count from its nominal pairs, using fixed stem/seed hash. Thus anchor inclusion and comparison counts match stable exactly, including zero-pair rows.
labels.rows: Calibrated score>=0.05 with>=2valid actions. Owned rows with eligible candidate18 perturbations get pair loss; unowned rows get identical keep-action logistic loss. Other rows have zero weight. No class, size or outcome balancing.
labels.loss: Per-row mean softplus(-nominal_pair_sign*(score_a-score_b)/0.05); common unowned loss softplus((alternative-keep)/0.05) averaged over valid alternatives. All active rows share unit weight; zero-pair owned rows contribute zero to fixed row denominator.

recipe.initialization: All arms start from the exact frozen uniform coordinate head (8641 parameters). Seeds change minibatch order and matched random thinning, not pretrained weights.
recipe.selection: Final epoch only; seed1/2 only if seed0 passes every primary gate.

inference: Frozen existing select_actions absolute rule, alternative-minus-keep>0.01; same score,class,count,order. No new NMS, confidence fit, abstention tuning, retraining detector or additional ignore filtering.
primary: Full64-image class-aware score-ordered one-to-one matching atconfidence0.25 and ten IoU thresholds0.50:0.05:0.95. Sum small_all TP over thresholds divided by10*small_all GT. This diagnostic threshold-averaged recall is not AP or official AR.
secondary: Same-owned meanIoU, threshold fraction and harm compared to uniform, full rematched recalls atIoU0.50 by size, allFPPI, moves, and pair-retention counts.
pass_action: Repeat seeds1/2; only after repeat gates pass register a bounded official no-training audit and closer robust-ranking literature comparison.
fail_action: Stop this stable-order recipe, no radius/learning-rate/epochs/head-size/threshold adjustment and no detector training.
budget: Zero detector forwards. Three8641-parameter heads x8epochs; at most9heads if seed0 passes. Cached geometry only.
limits: Finite synthetic corners need not describe annotation noise. Removing comparisons is established robust/partial-label learning; efficacy and prior-art distinction remain unproved. Fixed uniform ignore mask, head-held-out train scenes and diagnostic matching are not official independent evaluation.
